centralThread.basis: All 12 B briefs retain their selected central thread. The operator inspected titles, development and endpoints. Raw editorial defects capture local issues.

redundancy.basis: Mean reviewer-tagged repetitions fell from 2.67 to 1.58. Repetition within individual briefs is still present on at least three subjects, including Digital, DART and voting age.

peripheralDetail.basis: Mean reviewer-tagged peripheral items increased from 0.17 to 0.25. A one-item total increase across 12 subjects did not constitute a material recurring shift.

realizedEvidence.basis: B yields 1.06 more useful handoff items used per Article on the full paired set. This is an evidence-use pass only. Editorial development and acceptance have separate gates.

formatNeutrality.basis: All B texts preserve three progression bullets and the plain-content contract without channel instructions. The Git sparse factual review sets formatNeutral false without a supporting example, while its independent editorial review and the literal handoff are format-neutral. Eight unchanged LinkedIn calls succeeded and provide no clear evidence of a format-specific regression.

reliability.basis: All planned provider generation slots completed. Each treatment had three matched pre-provider archival CLI casing errors. Median holdout Narrative CLI latency was 5.4 s for A and 6.2 s for B.

independentCoverage.basis: All planned Narrative, Article and LinkedIn outputs have usable editorial and factual reviews after independent supplemental coverage and deterministic reconciliation. Source adjudication of disputed exact excerpts used full stage output and was not blind.

exactFreeze.basis: Verified original and revised freezes, values of recovered archived envelopes, 54 handoff hashes, source-limited exact C construction, Compose input equivalence and production prompt bytes.
